details.descriptionContent:
Solid stainless steel cat identification tag available in Gold, Rose Gold, and Silver finishes. Designed to keep your pet safe and easy to identify with deeply engraved lettering and an included heavy-duty split ring.

Personalize in seconds: pick from 23 cat silhouettes, your favorite metal finish, and 17 custom typography styles. The real-time 2D and 3D preview updates dynamically as you design.
details.shippingContent: Shipped with end-to-end tracking. You can request a return or exchange within 14 days of delivery. Free shipping on all orders over $50.
details.sizingContent: Surgical stainless steel measuring 35 × 32 mm (1.38 × 1.26 in) and 2.5 mm thickness. Ideal for kittens, adult cats, and small dogs.
details.materialsContent: 316L surgical-grade stainless steel, completely waterproof, rustproof, and scratch-resistant. Retains its shine and luster permanently.
